evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive issued from position authority sets cadence as mandate; the aphoristic conditional supplies the logical warrant for compliance.
Structural label restates the mandated cadence as an established parameter, reinforcing positional authority over the schedule.
Self-assignment of ownership label claims positional authority over the rehearsal program.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here being claimed by equating unexercised preparedness with absence of the capability itself?
